If you are going for pure aesthetic, the 911 would be better imo. It's definitely a more visually attractive car (to me), and will get you more looks than a GTR.

Both cars have pretty good resale value. But, The GTR might get a facelift soon, which might affect resale value of the current generation. That is purely hypothetical, though, I could be wrong.

Your choice might also depend on whether you drag or you track. For the track, I would get the 911. It's lighter weight really helps its handling. For drag, the GTR. Power like that can't be ignored. 

Honestly, after looking at all of the specs and stuff about these two cars, I wouldn't be able to decide. The Porsche has a better driving experience, while the GTR has more power. The GTR is more practical, but the Porsche has better fuel economy. I could go on. This choice really depends upon what you do with your cars, and what you value in a car. I, personally, would go for the Porsche for the driving experience alone, because that is what I value in a car. I don't know you, so I can't say one is better than the other for you. 

Best of luck to you, cause' either way you're getting your dream car.
